author: Tarkeshwar Narayan Sharma
name: SP8192 Frontier: 11L/4xMLP + TargetedRec + ParallelLaterRes + PartialRoPE + LyrNorm + MuonEq-R + GPTQ+SDClip + Brotli + LegalTTT
blurb: 11-layer dim=512 x MLP4x on SP8192 (locally retokenized). Targeted middle recurrence (layers 4..7 x 3, 19 effective). Parallel residuals from later layers (softmax mix). Partial RoPE 25%. Layerwise RMSNorm scale. QK gain 5.25. MuonEq-R + WD 0.09. EMA 0.9965. int6 GPTQ with SDClip (k=2.5) on matrices, int8 amax on embeddings. Byte-shuffle + Brotli-11 compression. Legal score-first sliding TTT (scope-once-per-token). Values in submission.json are auto-filled post-run by dev/fill_submission.py.
